833-1059-3827-5233.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3827-5233.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Boros Garrison, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3664-4067-7890.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.

1965-2034-5224-7729.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {2}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Omarthis, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

81-3099-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Innkeeper's Talent and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2921-6248-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-6248-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

955-2366-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
955-2366-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

489-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-2099-6972.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

57-647-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-647-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2921-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3693-5224-6747.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
2034-3693-5224-6747.notes: If you control an additional artifact, this combo will net infinite colorless mana, and you will pay {0} in step 1. Once you have infinite mana, you can use it to cast Walking Ballista, and then remove counters from it to deal damage.

628-2062-2366-6931.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
628-2062-2366-6931.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Marauding Raptor trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Dryad Arbor dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Dryad Arbor enters, Tourach's Chant and Marauding Raptor trigger.
Resolve the Tourach's Chant trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Marauding Raptor trigger, dealing damage to Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 4.

3560-5231-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

147-1223-6797.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-1223-6797.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities

678-997-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-997-6749.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

880-2653-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

439-4766-5683-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1418-4374-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1418-4374-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 2 life.
Repeat.

314-1738-3533.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Doomgape triggers, causing you to sacrifice Serra Avatar and gain life equal to its toughness.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

167-813-2292-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, it triggers, as well as any Wicked Role tokens that may have been attached to it.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger(s), if applicable, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard and creating a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All and Dark Ritual to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Sifter of Skulls and Mimic Vat trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Mimic Vat trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

803-1636-2366-3346-4147.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
"Mercenary" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.

Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

396-3681-5064.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Skirk Fire Marshal.
You control at least five untapped Goblins.

Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

292-3693-3921.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-3921.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

Sacrifice Ornithopter to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Ornithopter to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
